_llm_instructions: Populate the fields of 'Meeting Minutes' and write the value of each field under 'Generated Value', based on the project context. Context: the project carrying reference PMO-05.11.

f01_Meeting_Objective.label: Meeting Objective
f01_Meeting_Objective.guidance: What the meeting was called to settle, in one sentence. A purpose written after the meeting is a summary, and it is the only line that tells a reader whether anything was decided.

f02_Attendees.label: Attendees
f02_Attendees.guidance: Who was there, and who sent apologies. The list is not administrative: it is what tells a later reader whose agreement a decision carries, and who has to be told when the position changes.

f03_Key_Discussion_Points.label: Key Discussion Points
f03_Key_Discussion_Points.guidance: The matters discussed, with the reasoning recorded alongside the conclusion. A decision with no recorded reasoning is one that gets relitigated, because the next person cannot see what was weighed.

f04_Decisions_Made.label: Decisions Made
f04_Decisions_Made.guidance: What was agreed, one per entry, attributed to the meeting that agreed it. This section is the one that is read later, and anything not written here did not happen as far as the record is concerned.

f05_Action_Items.label: Action Items
f05_Action_Items.guidance: What was assigned, to whom, and by when. Written as a table because a task in a paragraph has no owner and no deadline a week later, and an action item without those two is a note.
